title: ParseJob
description: A parse job representing the asynchronous processing of a document.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parse job.

status.description: Current status of the parse job.

tier.description: Parsing tier used for this job.

num_pages.description: Total number of pages in the document.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the parse job was created.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the parse job completed, if applicable.
